origin: Named after the marquee above a theater entrance, where show names scrolled across. Early HTML even had a tag of the same name, <marquee>.
whenToUse: Several short, less important phrases, such as shipping or perks.
A thin strip at the very top of the page.
whenNotToUse: Announcements people must read (use a banner).
Between paragraphs of body text, where it disrupts reading.
accessibility: The second copy of the list is aria-hidden, so screen readers hear it once.
It stops on hover or when focus enters, and there's a pause button (WCAG 2.2.2).
With reduced motion, it doesn't scroll and wraps to show everything.
Name the whole strip with aria-label.
